text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Phew... haaahhh...—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: —The absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haha... You're tough as nails, Akebono...
Phew...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Somehow, Fuji-san's fighting spirit
really fired me up today, and I just refused to lose!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "It feels like it's been so long since I raced with all my might, like my body was gonna tear apart!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, likewise...!
Thank you for such a great race!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*! I-I was too!
I got so totally fired up!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: All the customers were smiling, too! Heheh, I might've really looked like Carrotman!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: —Haa~.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ah, sheesh, I can't move anymore~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, nice.
Guess I'll lie down too... Phew~.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. Are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "—And from the stands, thunderous applause rang out for the Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*, *sniffle*...!
That was so intense~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Right? I don't know why, but seeing everyone try so hard, I just couldn't take my eyes off them...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The race woven by the Umamusume in the Mile Championship,
led by Fuji Kiseki, was—

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Dammit!
...That was... incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She ignited a definite, burning passion in the hearts of the people!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“—Thank you so much!
Thanks to everyone cheering us on,
we were able to give it our all!”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Classic Year comes to a close.
Up next is the long-awaited Senior Year, teeming with absolute monsters!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And so, I promise you even greater miracles! Until then, a brief farewell!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki bowed respectfully,
then snapped her fingers—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
S-Smoke!?
—Wait, huh!? Where's Fuji Kiseki!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She made her exit in an exceptionally smart and stylish manner.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"About the next race to enter,
how about the 'Takamatsunomiya Kinen'?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right after returning home from Kyoto,
Fuji Kiseki visited the Trainer's office and said so.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of the Takamatsunomiya Kinen,
it's a 1200m turf sprint GⅠ race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Given her love for surprising people, I thought she might come up with a slightly more creative proposal.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Umm... could we leave that part for later?
I'd like some time to gather my thoughts!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "All I can say right now is—in the Senior Class, I want to surpass my shows from the Classic Class."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Have you seen them yet? So many people have written articles covering our Classic year journey, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: “A year spent running full throttle as an entertainer. Countless hearts were touched by her show.”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Expectations are high for her Senior Year campaign.
Her race rotation has not yet been announced, but—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Everyone is full of anticipation for the future she envisions"—ehe, that tickles a bit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: True, practically every article was lavishing praise on her performance to an almost overwhelming degree.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The Classic year came to a wonderful conclusion.
It was a greater success than we ever could have imagined!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That is why everyone is searching for an even greater miracle.
And I want to answer that call!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The chorus of praise did not cease for quite some time after that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Far from it; aided by Fuji Kiseki's charming demeanor,
flamboyant exits, and theatrical speeches,
her popularity skyrocketed—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Countless articles and endless clip videos
began to flood the internet day after day.
